package: @comp/kit

# KitPanel

A panel with an optional header.

**Import:** `import {KitPanel} from '@comp/kit/KitPanel';`

## Best Practices

- **Do:** Give every panel a header.

## Components

### KitPanel

The panel frame.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `padding` | `number` | `4` | Inner space. |

### KitPanelHeader

The panel header row.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `title` | `string` | - | Header text. **(required)** |
